# Sorevo

> Sorevo helps businesses appear in the answers of AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Claude). One fixed-price offer: visibility audit, action plan, content, structured data and a 30-day re-test with a before/after comparison. Founded by Jules Tommy Martin, based in Barcelona. Site available in French, English and Spanish.

Key facts:
- Offer: one package, 250 € launch price, one-off payment, no 12-month commitment. The starting mini-audit is free.
- Method: 30 realistic customer questions tested on several AI assistants, in fresh conversations, before and after. Sorevo measures how often a business is cited; it does not promise a ranking, since AI answers vary.
- Never included: fake reviews, fake forum posts, or publishing on a client's behalf without approval.
- Pilot programme: 2 to 3 free full audits for Barcelona SMEs in exchange for an honest testimonial.
- Contact: contact@sorevo.eu
